cues.zhText: 在病理学家眼里，急性阑尾炎的本质，始终绕不开两个核心动作——“变质”和“渗出”。
cues.enText: To a pathologist, acute appendicitis always revolves around two core processes: alteration and exudation.

cues.zhText: 当管腔被堵死、腔内压力飙升，黏膜屏障在缺血和细菌的双重夹击下迅速坏死、破溃脱落——这种组织细胞的损伤，就是“变质”。
cues.enText: Blocked and pressurized, the ischemic mucosa breaks down under bacterial attack—this cellular necrosis and ulceration is alteration.

cues.zhText: 警报一响，血管立刻扩张充血，把血浆和成群的分叶核中性粒细胞挤出血管壁，穿过内皮间隙，弥漫冲向阑尾壁全层——这就是“渗出”。
cues.enText: Alarmed vessels dilate, squeezing plasma and multi-lobed neutrophils through endothelial gaps to flood every wall layer—that is exudation.

cues.zhText: 战火一路烧穿肌层，直达最外层的浆膜。请仔细看浆膜表面渗出的东西：它可不只是单纯的纤维素，而是纤维素与脓液的混合渗出物。
cues.enText: The battle burns through the muscle to the outer serosa. Look closely: what oozes out is not pure fibrin, but a mix of fibrin and pus.

cues.zhText: 在交织成网的纤维素丝之间，密密麻麻裹挟着大量变性坏死的中性粒细胞，也就是脓细胞——这种“纤维素性脓性渗出物”，才是阑尾表面灰黄色的真正来源！
highlightZh: 变性坏死的中性粒细胞
cues.enText: Tangled within the fibrin mesh are legions of degenerated neutrophils—pus cells. This fibrinous-purulent exudate is the true source of that yellow color!
